WITH usable AS (
SELECT r.OrganizationIdentifier,r.ActivityIdentifier,r.USGSPCode,CAST(r.ResultMeasureValue AS REAL) AS val
FROM r JOIN a ON r.OrganizationIdentifier=a.OrganizationIdentifier AND r.ActivityIdentifier=a.ActivityIdentifier AND r.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=a.MonitoringLocationIdentifier AND r.ActivityStartDate=a.ActivityStartDate
WHERE a.ActivityTypeCode='Sample-Routine' AND a.ActivityMediaName='Water'
AND r.ResultStatusIdentifier IN ('Accepted','Final') AND r.ResultValueTypeName='Actual' AND r.ResultDetectionConditionText='' AND r.MeasureQualifierCode=''
AND ((r.USGSPCode='00010' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='deg C') OR (r.USGSPCode='00095' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='uS/cm @25C') OR (r.USGSPCode='00300' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='mg/l') OR (r.USGSPCode='00400' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='std units'))
), p AS (
SELECT OrganizationIdentifier,ActivityIdentifier,USGSPCode,MIN(val) AS val,COUNT(DISTINCT val) AS n FROM usable GROUP BY 1,2,3
), panels AS (
SELECT OrganizationIdentifier,ActivityIdentifier,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00010' THEN val END) AS temp,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00095' THEN val END) AS conductance,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00300' THEN val END) AS oxygen,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00400' THEN val END) AS ph
FROM p GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)=4 AND MAX(n)=1
)
SELECT a.OrganizationIdentifier,a.ActivityIdentifier,a.MonitoringLocationIdentifier,a.ActivityStartDate,a."ActivityStartTime/Time" AS clock,
CAST(substr(a.ActivityStartDate,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
1+(CAST(substr(a.ActivityStartDate,6,2) AS INTEGER)-1)/3 AS quarter,
panels.temp,panels.conductance,panels.oxygen,panels.ph
FROM panels JOIN a ON panels.OrganizationIdentifier=a.OrganizationIdentifier AND panels.ActivityIdentifier=a.ActivityIdentifier

WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 2000 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019),
support AS (SELECT OrganizationIdentifier,MonitoringLocationIdentifier,CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS y FROM p GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT quarter)=4),
windows AS (SELECT x.y AS start_year,z.y AS end_year,z.y-x.y+1 AS duration FROM years x JOIN years z ON z.y>=x.y),
cohorts AS (
SELECT w.start_year,w.end_year,w.duration,s.OrganizationIdentifier,s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier
FROM windows w JOIN support s ON s.y BETWEEN w.start_year AND w.end_year
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 HAVING COUNT(*)=w.duration
),
feasible AS (SELECT start_year,end_year,duration,COUNT(*) AS coverage FROM cohorts GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>=2),
frontier AS (SELECT f.* FROM feasible f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feasible g WHERE g.duration>=f.duration AND g.coverage>=f.coverage AND (g.duration>f.duration OR g.coverage>f.coverage))),
ranked AS (
SELECT f.start_year,f.end_year,f.coverage,p.*,s.HUCEightDigitCode,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.start_year,f.end_year,p.OrganizationIdentifier,p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier,p.quarter) AS n,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.start_year,f.end_year,p.OrganizationIdentifier,p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier,p.quarter ORDER BY CAST(p.oxygen AS REAL),p.ActivityStartDate,CASE WHEN p.clock='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,p.clock,p.ActivityIdentifier COLLATE BINARY) AS rn
FROM frontier f JOIN cohorts c ON f.start_year=c.start_year AND f.end_year=c.end_year
JOIN p ON p.OrganizationIdentifier=c.OrganizationIdentifier AND p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=c.MonitoringLocationIdentifier AND CAST(p.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN f.start_year AND f.end_year
JOIN s ON s.OrganizationIdentifier=p.OrganizationIdentifier AND s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier
)
SELECT start_year,end_year,coverage,OrganizationIdentifier,MonitoringLocationIdentifier,HUCEightDigitCode,'Q'||quarter,n,ActivityIdentifier,ActivityStartDate,printf('%.2f',CAST(oxygen AS REAL)),printf('%.2f',CAST(temp AS REAL)),printf('%.2f',CAST(conductance AS REAL)),printf('%.2f',CAST(ph AS REAL)) FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY start_year,end_year,MonitoringLocationIdentifier,CAST(quarter AS INTEGER)
SELECT ActivityTypeCode,ActivityMediaName,COUNT(*) AS n FROM a GROUP BY 1,2

WITH usable AS (
SELECT r.OrganizationIdentifier, r.ActivityIdentifier, r.USGSPCode, CAST(r.ResultMeasureValue AS REAL) AS value
FROM r JOIN a ON r.OrganizationIdentifier=a.OrganizationIdentifier AND r.ActivityIdentifier=a.ActivityIdentifier AND r.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=a.MonitoringLocationIdentifier AND r.ActivityStartDate=a.ActivityStartDate
JOIN s ON a.OrganizationIdentifier=s.OrganizationIdentifier AND a.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier
WHERE a.ActivityMediaName='Water' AND a.ActivityTypeCode='Sample-Routine'
AND a.ActivityStartDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
AND r.ResultStatusIdentifier IN ('Accepted','Final') AND r.ResultValueTypeName='Actual'
AND trim(coalesce(r.ResultDetectionConditionText,''))='' AND trim(coalesce(r.MeasureQualifierCode,''))=''
AND ((r.USGSPCode='00010' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='deg C') OR
(r.USGSPCode='00095' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='uS/cm @25C') OR
(r.USGSPCode='00300' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='mg/l') OR
(r.USGSPCode='00400' AND r."ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode"='std units'))
), per_code AS (
SELECT OrganizationIdentifier, ActivityIdentifier, USGSPCode, MIN(value) value, COUNT(DISTINCT value) distinct_values, COUNT(*) result_count FROM usable GROUP BY 1,2,3
), complete AS (
SELECT OrganizationIdentifier, ActivityIdentifier,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00010' THEN value END) temperature,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00095' THEN value END) conductance,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00300' THEN value END) oxygen,
MAX(CASE WHEN USGSPCode='00400' THEN value END) ph
FROM per_code GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)=4 AND MAX(distinct_values)=1
)

a.ActivityRelativeDepthName,a."ActivityDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureValue" depth,a."ActivityDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureUnitCode" depth_unit,a.ActivityDepthAltitudeReferencePointText,
a."ActivityTopDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureValue" top_depth,a."ActivityTopDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureUnitCode" top_unit,
a."ActivityBottomDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureValue" bottom_depth,a."ActivityBottomDepthHeightMeasure/MeasureUnitCode" bottom_unit,
CAST(substr(a.ActivityStartDate,1,4) AS INTEGER) year, ((CAST(substr(a.ActivityStartDate,6,2) AS INTEGER)-1)/3)+1 quarter
FROM complete c JOIN a ON c.OrganizationIdentifier=a.OrganizationIdentifier AND c.ActivityIdentifier=a.ActivityIdentifier

WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 2000 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019),
intervals AS (SELECT a.y start_year,b.y end_year,b.y-a.y+1 duration FROM years a CROSS JOIN years b WHERE a.y<=b.y),
cohorts AS (SELECT i.start_year,i.end_year,i.duration,s.OrganizationIdentifier,s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier FROM intervals i CROSS JOIN s WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sy WHERE sy.OrganizationIdentifier=s.OrganizationIdentifier AND sy.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier AND CAST(sy.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN i.start_year AND i.end_year)=i.duration),
feasible AS (SELECT start_year,end_year,duration,COUNT(*) coverage FROM cohorts GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>=2),
frontier AS (SELECT * FROM feasible f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feasible g WHERE g.duration>=f.duration AND g.coverage>=f.coverage AND (g.duration>f.duration OR g.coverage>f.coverage))) SELECT f.*,group_concat(c.MonitoringLocationIdentifier,',') stations FROM frontier f JOIN cohorts c ON f.start_year=c.start_year AND f.end_year=c.end_year GROUP BY f.start_year,f.end_year ORDER BY f.start_year,f.end_year

WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 2000 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019),
intervals AS (SELECT a.y start_year,b.y end_year,b.y-a.y+1 duration FROM years a CROSS JOIN years b WHERE a.y<=b.y),
cohorts AS (SELECT i.start_year,i.end_year,i.duration,s.OrganizationIdentifier,s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier FROM intervals i CROSS JOIN s WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sy WHERE sy.OrganizationIdentifier=s.OrganizationIdentifier AND sy.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier AND CAST(sy.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN i.start_year AND i.end_year)=i.duration),
feasible AS (SELECT start_year,end_year,duration,COUNT(*) coverage FROM cohorts GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>=2),
frontier AS (SELECT * FROM feasible f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feasible g WHERE g.duration>=f.duration AND g.coverage>=f.coverage AND (g.duration>f.duration OR g.coverage>f.coverage))) SELECT duration,coverage,COUNT(*) interval_count FROM feasible GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH RECURSIVE years(y) AS (SELECT 2000 UNION ALL SELECT y+1 FROM years WHERE y<2019),
intervals AS (SELECT a.y start_year,b.y end_year,b.y-a.y+1 duration FROM years a CROSS JOIN years b WHERE a.y<=b.y),
cohorts AS (SELECT i.start_year,i.end_year,i.duration,s.OrganizationIdentifier,s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier FROM intervals i CROSS JOIN s WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sy WHERE sy.OrganizationIdentifier=s.OrganizationIdentifier AND sy.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=s.MonitoringLocationIdentifier AND CAST(sy.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN i.start_year AND i.end_year)=i.duration),
feasible AS (SELECT start_year,end_year,duration,COUNT(*) coverage FROM cohorts GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(*)>=2),
frontier AS (SELECT * FROM feasible f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feasible g WHERE g.duration>=f.duration AND g.coverage>=f.coverage AND (g.duration>f.duration OR g.coverage>f.coverage))) SELECT c.*,f.coverage FROM frontier f JOIN cohorts c ON f.start_year=c.start_year AND f.end_year=c.end_year ORDER BY c.start_year,c.end_year,c.MonitoringLocationIdentifier

WITH candidates AS (
SELECT CAST(f.start_year AS INTEGER) start_year, CAST(f.end_year AS INTEGER) end_year, CAST(f.coverage AS INTEGER) cohort_station_count, p.*,
COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.start_year,f.end_year,p.OrganizationIdentifier,p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier,p.quarter) eligible_activity_count,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.start_year,f.end_year,p.OrganizationIdentifier,p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier,p.quarter
ORDER BY CAST(p.oxygen AS REAL),p.ActivityStartDate,CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(p.clock_time,''))='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,p.clock_time,p.ActivityIdentifier COLLATE BINARY) event_rank
FROM f JOIN p ON f.OrganizationIdentifier=p.OrganizationIdentifier AND f.MonitoringLocationIdentifier=p.MonitoringLocationIdentifier
AND CAST(p.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN CAST(f.start_year AS INTEGER) AND CAST(f.end_year AS INTEGER))
SELECT start_year,end_year,cohort_station_count,OrganizationIdentifier,MonitoringLocationIdentifier,HUCEightDigitCode,'Q'||quarter quarter,eligible_activity_count,ActivityIdentifier,ActivityStartDate,oxygen,temperature,conductance,ph,clock_time,depth,depth_unit FROM candidates WHERE event_rank=1 ORDER BY start_year,end_year,MonitoringLocationIdentifier,quarter

independence: Each received only the public task/date/output format plus the appropriate stage prompt and solver result schema in a new isolated Docker/Codex context. Probe/config/history details remain per-run. No fork/resume or host bind mounts.
correctness_scope: Scores measure exact declared output semantics against independently recomputed source gold; same-model agreement alone does not establish source truth.
status_fields: Runtime completion event, exit status, self-reported status, answer parsing and metrics are separate. HTTP errors remain recorded; complete transport with HTTP500 is not valid source data.
